Team — forwarding HelixBio ask and attachments. Summary and asks below.

Summary: Helix (prospect -> fast-scaling biotech) wants to sign a 12-month Dedicated commit targeted at H200-family. They need a short-term reservation hold (to avoid immediate placement on non-H200 hardware) while we validate Q3 inventory, plus a capped burst allowance (~40-50% of baseline) that would otherwise trigger high overage pricing. Procurement wants terms in place to proceed with PO and DocuSign by 6/25.

Specific asks for exec signoff / Deal Desk approval:
- Approve temporary reservation hold for up to 30 days while Redwood confirms H200 inventory for their commit window. Hold would pause final assignment but not the billing start date unless otherwise noted.
- Approve overage concession: flat 20% discount on published overage rate for any burst usage that occurs during the hold window (Q3 provisioning risk window).
- Allow explicit fallback clause: if we cannot supply H200 within 30 days, assign H100-family with a credit to account for perf delta (SE team will provide quantization guidance).
- Condition: Helix signs an amendment acknowledging the provisional nature and commits to a defined commit size within 7 business days of sign (will include PO evidence).

Why this matters: Helix is a high-fit account (large anticipated committed spend), but supply constraints are real. Offering a guarded, time-limited concession helps close the deal now without carving a permanent pricing precedent.

Attachments: helix_proposed_mop.pdf, supply_projection_q3.xlsx, handshake_proposal_v1.pdf

5) Exec visibility: I will approve the concession on the condition that we treat this as a one-off and maintain an internal note in the Deal Desk record. Diego — send the amended DocuSign wrapper; do not publish any public pricing collateral referencing this concession.
